about.viewport: 1440x900 desktop; 390x844 phone for the ten pages the first composite ranked busiest
about.region: #main (page area: no rail, no program menu, no top bar); side panels measured as #panel

definitions.nonGrey: OKLCH chroma >= 0.016 after compositing alpha over white (the neutral ramp tops out at 0.014)
definitions.hueFamilies: red <40 or >=350, amber 40-115, green 115-170, teal 170-215, blue 215-275, violet 275-320, pink 320-350 (OKLCH hue)
definitions.colourfulPixels: share of page-area pixels with OKLCH chroma >= 0.04 in the 1440x900 screenshot (Vanta: the whole screenshot)
definitions.cues: pills/chips/tags + charts and meters + cards + banners + buttons + icons and glyphs, above the fold (tabs and table frames not counted)
definitions.colouredMarks: outermost elements above the fold that paint any non-grey colour (a pill with its glyph counts once)
definitions.fontPairs: distinct font-size/font-weight pairs on text-bearing elements
definitions.tonedCellsPerRow: cells of the first table, first 8 rows, that paint a non-grey colour (avatars and checkboxes aside)
definitions.caveat: Counts are heuristics over the DOM: hidden demo menus and the who-ring glyph were corrected after a first pass; record the screenshot beside each number before quoting it.
